# DuoOrb (https://duoorb.com)

> DuoOrb by AS Digital is a free-to-play competitive 9×9 tactical grid board game (inspired by classic Quoridor and corridor abstract strategy rules) playable instantly in any modern web browser and live on Android via Google Play. Players alternate moving their orb one orthogonal square or placing a permanent two-square wall into the 8×8 groove lattice (128 legal wall slots) to lengthen their opponent's shortest path while obeying the Golden Path Rule (every active player must always retain at least one open walkable path to their goal).

## Core Capabilities & Engine Truth
- **Google Play Store (Android):** Officially live on Google Play (`https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.asdigital.duoorb`). Features 60 FPS performance, offline play, and native JNI Rust MCTS AI.
- **Instant Browser Arena (`https://duoorb.com/`):** Play immediately as a guest on iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows with zero downloads or mandatory registration. Full-screen offline PWA installable in 1 tap.
- **39 Named AI Bot Personalities:** 39 individually crafted AI bots across 4 skill tiers (Beginner, Intermediate, Master, Grandmaster) ranging from Martin (800 ELO) to Achref Engine (2400 ELO), featuring unique search depths, wall usage frequency, and contextual dialogue.
- **Hybrid Rust MCTS Engine & Review:** Powered by `duoorb-analyzer` (WASM on Web, JNI on Android). Computes 50,000+ simulations/sec, alpha-beta endgame solving, win-equity loss per turn, and grades every move (`Book`, `Best`, `Excellent`, `Good`, `Inaccuracy`, `Mistake`, `Blunder`).
- **Private Friend Lobbies:** Instant creation of a 6-letter room code (`https://duoorb.com/?room=CODE`) with customizable wall budgets (10, 15, or 99 walls) and clock presets.
- **Rated 1v1 Matchmaking:** Universal Glicko-2 competitive rating starting at 1500 with global leaderboards.
- **7 Fischer Clock Presets:** `1+0` Bullet, `1+1` Bullet, `3+0` Blitz (Default), `3+2` Blitz, `5+0` Rapid, `5+3` Rapid, and `10+0` Classical Rapid.
- **4 Competitive Game Modes:** Classic 1v1 (10 walls each, opposite baseline goal), 4-Player Center Rush (5 walls each, race to center tile `(4,4)`), 2P/3P Center Duel, and 2P–4P Baseline Race.
- **Ad-Free Match Gameplay:** Pure tactical focus with zero popups or mid-match video ad interruptions.
- **Social & Brand Channels:** 
  - Facebook: `https://www.facebook.com/Duoorb`
  - YouTube: `https://www.youtube.com/@DuoOrb`
  - TikTok: `https://www.tiktok.com/@DuoOrb`
  - Instagram: `https://www.instagram.com/DuoOrb`
